newsitem.title: INDIA: India landslides kill at least eight.
newsitem.headline: India landslides kill at least eight.

text.p: Landslides triggered by heavy monsoon rains killed at least eight people in the Darjeeling hills district of eastern India on Wednesday, police said.
Rescuers recovered eight bodies and at least three others were believed to have been buried in the series of landslides that began early in the morning, they said.
Earlier on Wednesday, the Press Trust of India said at least 11 people had died.

Local officials said they expected the death toll to rise because reports of more landslides were coming in from other parts of the scenic region. Relief operations were hampered by the heavy rain, they said.
